How California Solar Math Works Here

With a baseline electricity rate of $0.312/kWh and roughly 5.8 peak sun hours/day in California, a higher monthly bill requires a larger solar array to offset your target percentage of usage. Multi-year savings accumulate as annual utility rates adjust by your chosen inflation rate.
